name: Mahanadi Coalfields
summary: Mahanadi Coalfields, a Coal India subsidiary incorporated in 1992, mines non-coking coal from 17 mines in Odisha's Talcher and Ib Valley coalfields and produced 218.31 million tonnes in FY26, about 21% of India's output. Revenue from operations slipped from ₹31,634 cr in FY24 to ₹30,550 cr in FY26 and profit after tax fell 1.2% in FY26 to ₹10,698 cr, though return on net worth was 53.9% and the company is almost debt-free. The issue is entirely an offer for sale of 66.18 crore shares (about 10%) by Coal India, so the company receives no money, and the price band had not been announced when this report was written, so valuation checks are not rated. Top 10 customers, mainly thermal power utilities, give 55.9% of revenue, and contingent liabilities are about 39.8% of net worth.

fh1.finding: Revenue from operations fell from ₹31,634 cr (FY24) to ₹30,550 cr (FY26), a CAGR of about -1.7%.

fh2.finding: Revenue from operations fell in both years: ₹31,634 cr, ₹31,353 cr, ₹30,550 cr (FY24–FY26).

fh3.finding: Borrowings were about ₹3 cr at March 2026 against net worth of ₹21,371 cr, so debt to equity is close to zero.

fh4.finding: Total borrowings fell from ₹3.95 cr (FY24) to ₹3.16 cr (FY26).

fh5.finding: Net worth rose every year: ₹16,120 cr, ₹18,343 cr, ₹21,371 cr (FY24–FY26).

fh6.finding: Operating cash flow was ₹12,478 cr in FY26, above the ₹10,698 cr profit.

pr1.finding: Profit after tax fell 1.2% in FY26, to ₹10,698 cr from ₹10,825 cr, after falling from ₹11,842 cr in FY24.

pr2.finding: PAT as a share of total income fell from about 35.3% (FY24) to 31.6% (FY26).

pr3.finding: Return on net worth was 53.87% in FY26, down from 62.82% in FY25 and 80.56% in FY24.

pr5.finding: Peer margins were not found in public sources.

va1.finding: The price band had not been announced, so the post-issue P/E cannot be computed.

va2.finding: The price band had not been announced, so the post-issue price to book cannot be computed.

va3.finding: The price band had not been announced, so market cap to sales cannot be computed.

va4.finding: No details of pre-IPO share issues or transfers were found in public sources.

pg1.finding: Promoters (Coal India and the President of India) hold 100% before and 90% after the issue.

pg2.finding: No information on pledged promoter shares was found.

pg3.finding: Related-party transaction figures were not found in public sources.

pg4.finding: No information on regulatory action against promoters was found.

is1.finding: The whole issue is an offer for sale of 66.18 crore shares by Coal India; there is no fresh issue.

is2.finding: The offer is about 10% of the company; promoter holding falls from 100% to 90%.

is3.finding: Coal India's acquisition cost per share was not found in public sources.

up1.finding: The company receives none of the proceeds, so nothing funds capex or expansion.

up2.finding: No proceeds go to repaying debt; all go to the selling shareholder.

up3.finding: No proceeds go to general corporate purposes; all go to the selling shareholder.

up4.finding: No proceeds reach the company, so none repay loans from promoters or group companies.

lg1.finding: The DRHP lists criminal, tax and regulatory proceedings totalling ₹9,084.8 cr (about 42% of FY26 net worth), plus a CAG observation on state mineral levies with potential exposure of about ₹31,228 cr.

lg2.finding: The DRHP lists 47 criminal and 52 regulatory proceedings; public sources don't say how material they are.

lg3.finding: Contingent liabilities were 39.80% of net worth at March 31, 2026.

rk1.finding: Top 10 customers gave 55.94% of FY26 revenue from operations; thermal power was 68.62% of sales.

rk2.finding: Top 10 contractors took 60.02% of contract expenses, but no single-supplier share was found.

rk3.finding: Incorporated on April 3, 1992, giving over 34 years of operating history.

rk4.finding: Auditor remarks were not found in public sources.
